en.title: Skywalker Saga Continues: Jon Watts Tapped for New Star Wars Trilogy
en.summary: The galaxy far, far away is set to expand once more, with reports indicating a new Star Wars trilogy helmed by director Jon Watts. This ambitious project aims to continue the Skywalker Saga, potentially bringing back familiar faces while introducing new heroes.
en.body:
The echoes of lightsabers and the hum of hyperspace engines are set to resonate once more, as news emerges that director **Jon Watts** is reportedly set to helm the first film in a new Star Wars trilogy. This ambitious endeavor aims to extend the Skywalker Saga, a narrative arc that has captivated audiences for generations across nine previous films.

Watts, known for his work on the Marvel Cinematic Universe's Spider-Man trilogy and co-creating the upcoming Disney+ series *Star Wars: Skeleton Crew*, is said to be directing the first installment, tentatively referred to as "Episode X." According to reports, the script for this new chapter is being penned by **Simon Kinberg**, a veteran of the Star Wars universe. While the official greenlight from Disney is still pending, sources suggest this project is further along in development than other planned Star Wars features, with casting reportedly underway for new lead characters.

## A New Chapter for the Skywalker Legacy

The potential return of **Rey Skywalker**, portrayed by **Daisy Ridley**, is a significant point of discussion. While her role in the first film is rumored to be minor, her presence hints at a direct continuation of the narrative threads established in the sequel trilogy. The casting of "relatively unknown" male and female leads suggests a focus on introducing a fresh generation of heroes to carry the torch, a familiar pattern within the sprawling Star Wars mythology. This move by Lucasfilm and Disney signals a continued commitment to exploring the Skywalker lineage, even as the franchise has also ventured into standalone stories and different eras.

## Fan Reception and Future Possibilities

News of a continuation of the Skywalker Saga, especially one helmed by a director with proven blockbuster experience like **Jon Watts**, is bound to ignite passionate discussion among the global fanbase. The desire for new, compelling Star Wars stories is ever-present, and the promise of exploring uncharted territory within this beloved universe offers a tantalizing prospect. However, the fate of any new trilogy also rests on official confirmation and the reception of early development stages. The franchise has seen projects evolve and change course, making the anticipation for concrete details all the more fervent.

## What's Next

While official confirmation and release dates are yet to be announced, the development of this new Skywalker Saga trilogy is a significant step. Fans will be watching closely for casting announcements, plot details, and official statements from Lucasfilm. The project is reportedly further along than *Star Wars: Starfighter*, which has a May 27, 2027 release date, suggesting this new trilogy could begin to materialize in the coming years.

content_raw: News Star Wars Somehow, the Skywalker Saga Continues; Jon Watts to Direct New Star Wars Movie Watts has directed three Spider-Man films in the Marvel Cinematic Universe and co-created Star Wars: Skeleton Crew By Vanessa Armstrong | Published on September 28, 2026 Photo Credit: Disney Comment 0 Share New Share Photo Credit: Disney Jon Watts, who directed three of the Marvel Cinematic Universe’s Spider-Man films, has been tapped to direct the first film in a new Skywalker trilogy written by Simon Kinberg, because apparently the nine movies already in the Skywalker Saga aren’t enough. According to Knight Edge Media , which broke the news (that has also been confirmed by The Hollywood Reporter ), the first movie in the trilogy (aka “Episode X”) will see the return of Rey Skywalker (Daisy Ridley) in a minor role. It’s unknown whether Rey will have a larger part in the two sequels Kinberg has also reportedly written, but casting is apparently underway for “relatively unknown” male and female leads. It should also be noted that the project hasn’t been officially greenlit yet by the Disney-higher ups, so there’s still a chance that this film could go the way of the Kylo Ren sequel, The Hunt for Ben Solo , that was nixed by Disney’s CEO at the time. THR ’s sources say, however, that this movie is the one farthest along in terms of development after Star Wars: Starfighter , which is set to come out on May 27, 2027. This isn’t the first time Watts has worked in the Star Wars universe; he’s also the co-creator of the Disney+ series Skeleton Crew , where a group of kids get caught up in a Goonies- esque adventure. What story the tenth Skywalker Saga film will tackle remains to be seen, but odds are good that there will be at least one lightsaber and one cute droid involved.[end-mark] The post Somehow, the Skywalker Saga Continues; Jon Watts to Direct New Star Wars Movie appeared first on Reactor .
